objective: Validate decimal precision preservation and detect representation regressions before release.
rationale: A data transformation can remain numerically equivalent while violating declared precision, so exact differential comparison and evidence are required.

scenarios.name: zero_decimal_precision
scenarios.assertion: candidate values must exactly match expected string representation

scenarios.name: non_zero_decimal_precision
scenarios.assertion: candidate values must exactly match expected string representation
scenarios.expected: non-zero values retain two decimal places
